decision: APPROVE bounded owned-Edge placement source change; no material blocker found
scope: Read complete delivery README and all four changed source files, reviewed emitted assembly and focused call flow. One focused portable15 check and3 Node syntax checks only. No Windows/PowerShell/parser/compiler/device/display/audio/account calls, no network and no repository edits.
observations: Owned Edge uses existing Raise without its temporary TOPMOST/NOTOPMOST pulse. Generic control Raise is unchanged; no Explorer or other foreign window is changed by new helper calls.

A single normal-to-fullscreen CDP transition is restricted to before any product launch, and validates both acknowledgements, window id/state and owned native handle/owner. Unknown native/style metadata fails closed.

All16 exact-root observations are retained before rejection, with same card/corner positions. Read-only class, physical bounds, foreground, TOPMOST, minimized and relative order evidence supplements the original PID predicate.

Control option center uses native physical client origin/size/DPI plus current DOM viewport/DPR, then verifies exact top-level control root and stable client bounds. Its Raise precedes existing Edge Raise/truth/all16 and immediate fresh surface admission before Start.
Capture-attempt flag is set before CDP invocation, so even an unknown Start result prevents the added control-placement phase from raising control afterward.
Overlay phase follows first frame, reads ownership/TOPMOST/order only and returns before control code. Existing drag/Stop and exact-process cleanup remain unchanged.

Default builder reproduces historical runner/steps; old fixed candidate and failed evidence have no diff from parent. The new candidate remains distinct and is intentionally not admitted by the unchanged historical wrapper.
limits: Portable15 is source/assembly mutation checks plus actual browser predicate under synthetic Node VM DOM, not execution of PowerShell/C#/Win32/CDP or true placement.
Sequential native/window observations and16-point sampling do not establish atomic whole-screen isolation. Foreground/style and geometry can change after admission.
New native parsing/compilation and actual geometry/order/fullscreen/operability are not verified by this reviewer; Lead handles its separate native admission audit.
The observed historical Explorer cause remains unknown. Source approval does not claim placement repair has worked on Windows.
Existing human process-scoped RemoteSigned approval remains resolved. New candidate admission/resource coordination remains Lead-owned; no duplicate human permission gate is requested.
